title: Halo CE enemies (HDE version)
load: Bundle: HDE (Local_DEV) -> HDE_CE_Covenant.pk3 (Core + Covenant + voices + API; nothing else).   Separate packs: HDE -> HCE_EnemyAPI_LocalDEV.pk3 -> HaloCE_Core.pk3 -> HaloCE_Covenant.pk3 / HaloCE_Flood.pk3 / HaloCE_Sentinels.pk3 / HaloCE_Marines.pk3 -> HaloCE_Enemies_Voices.pk3, or HDE -> HaloCE_Merged.pk3 for everything. Never load the bundle together with HaloCE_Core or HCE_EnemyAPI_LocalDEV.

bundle.name: HDE_CE_Covenant
header: // Halo CE enemies, HDE bundle: the Covenant (Grunts, Jackals, Elites, Hunters, and the Digsite add-on's Drinol +
// Cyberdemon boss, Slug Men, carbine / pulse-carbine Elites, Blind Wolf, Thorn Beast, Engineer, Drones, Brutes),
// the enemy dialogue, the enemy API (ZScript/BaseAI/enemies_base.zsc, replaces HDE's file of that path) and the Core code.
// Load after HaloDoom Evolved (Local_DEV). Don't load HaloCE_Core / HCE_EnemyAPI_LocalDEV with it.
